snippet.title: Band of Crusaders - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Band of Crusaders is an upcoming dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become the Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead the crusade against demons to save Europe.

Wishlist now on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2526570/Band_of_Crusaders/
